title: Keto Apple Wonton Soup
description: A keto twist on traditional wonton soup, featuring tender wontons filled with a sweet apple filling, served in a savory broth.

ingredients.name: Kissed Pork Filling
ingredients.notes: mix with 1/4 cup chopped scallions and 1 tablespoon soy sauce

ingredients.name: Chinese Soup Spices
ingredients.notes: mix of soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil

instructions: 2. In a medium bowl, mix together the Kissed Pork Filling ingredients.
3. Lay a Buttery Wonton Wrapper on a flat surface and place a small spoonful of the pork filling in the center of the wrapper.
4. Dip your finger in a small amount of Keto-Friendly Cooking Oil and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
5. Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point, pressing the edges together to seal the wonton.
6. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
7. In a large pot, heat the Chicken Broth over medium-high heat until it starts to simmer.
8. Add the Chinese Soup Spices and stir to combine.
9. Carefully add the wontons to the pot and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
10. Add the diced Cox Apple to the pot and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the apples are tender.
11. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
12. Serve the wontons and apples in bowls and enjoy!
